_notes.separation: Baseline/evaluation configuration only. The dataset (a P5.3 window run directory) is passed on the command line and verified against window_config_reference.
_notes.B1: max_lookback_samples 5 = search all six history samples backward from the anchor for the latest valid Task 2 causal velocity. No fallback: no valid velocity -> window invalid (never zero velocity).
_notes.B2: Least squares over valid history samples with timestamps centred at their mean; needs >= 3 valid samples, a time span >= 0.2 s (two 10 Hz intervals) and centred time variance > 1e-6 s^2; prediction anchored at the last observed position. Thresholds fixed before any pilot result was seen.
_notes.miss_rate_threshold_px: null = not configured: no defensible pixel threshold has been approved (pixel distances are depth-dependent).
_notes.std_ddof: population standard deviation (ddof 0) over evaluated windows; descriptive only.
_notes.partial_target_policy: STRICT_FULL_HORIZON: windows with any invalid target step are excluded and counted, never zero-filled.
_notes.invalid_prediction_policy: EXCLUDE_AND_COUNT: invalid predictions are excluded and counted per reason; comparisons are also reported on the common set of windows evaluated by every baseline.
